title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch | TechCrunch
summary: Town, a two-year-old, San Francisco-based startup developing AI assistants, nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B funding round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.
